 Lee Child and Andrew Child will release Chain Reaction on October 20, 2026, bringing Jack Reacher back in the 31st novel of the thriller series. The book reunites Reacher with General Susan Turner as they investigate a dangerous conspiracy. According to Collider, Chain Reaction continues the story of Reacher, a former military police officer who travels without permanent ties and repeatedly becomes involved in complex investigations.
 The novel is written by Lee Child with Andrew Child and follows 2025's Exit Strategy. Crime Fiction Lover reported that the story begins when General Susan Turner, now based inside the Pentagon, seeks Reacher's help after a member of her team is killed during a covert mission. Reacher is drawn into a case involving hidden threats and a location called Summertown, Colorado.

 According to Collider, Turner has advanced from her previous role leading the 110th Military Police Special Investigations Unit to become a general. Her return connects the new story with events from Never Go Back, where her relationship with Reacher was a major element.

 The novel places Reacher against a mystery involving artificial intelligence, corporate espionage, and a broad conspiracy, according to Collider. The story also moves the character into a conflict between traditional investigative methods and a technology-focused environment. Polygon reported that the release follows continued interest in the character after the Prime Video adaptation starring Alan Ritchson. The television series has expanded the audience for Lee Child's novels, while the books provide additional stories beyond the screen adaptations.
 According to Polygon, Andrew Child previously collaborated with Lee Child on multiple Reacher novels after first joining the series with The Sentinel in 2020. Chain Reaction marks the latest installment carrying both authors' names. Collider reported that the novel features the return of familiar characters while introducing a new investigation requiring Reacher's skills. Chain Reaction is scheduled for publication on October 20, 2026.
